stemMd: If the alarm had worked, the guard would have been notified. The guard was not notified. Therefore the alarm did not work. Which argument has the same form?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Some members are singers. All singers practise, so all members practise.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The oven is hot because its thermostat is high.

options.label: C
options.textMd: If the soil is dry, watering is needed. The soil is not dry, so watering is not needed.

options.label: D
options.textMd: If the parcel had been scanned, a tracking entry would exist. No entry exists, so the parcel was not scanned.

options.label: E
options.textMd: If the lamp is on, the room is lit. The room is lit, so the lamp is on.

explanationMd: The pattern denies a necessary consequence: if the first event occurred, the second would occur; the second did not occur; therefore the first did not occur. The tracking argument uses that same valid structure.

distractorRationale.b: This is a causal explanation rather than a conditional denial.
distractorRationale.a: This changes a particular premise into a universal conclusion.
